title: Page 106
transc:
JW Sampson Wash July 3d 1864
Nancy for John W Garrett zodiac
Mutton has been under orders pebble
days ago to move his saints
up tooth wheighed vernons zebra Dangers
pacific should have been up before
now yoke Brutus keep hand in


125 AM 4th WB Gilmore Chambersburg
Baltimore third midnight for Koran Myrtle 
Have you any information as to
the movement of the Olive in
the Valley of the safety of
pagan Sigels trains or of any
engage meant he has had with
the rebels Please answer by telegraph
sig pagan Lew Wall ace end


WB Gilmore Chambersburg
Balto 4th for Koran Myrtle period
obliged to you for telegram Please
keep me posted well as you 
can of olive move ments any 
thing definite as to their strength
signed Pagan Lew Wall lace fourth
